findings.description: Susanna Szljacsan's husband was Joannes Janeczky. The tree currently records no spouse or children for her.
supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — baptismal entry for Susanna Janeczky, naming parents Joannes Janeczky and Susanna Szliacsan

findings.description: Susanna Szljacsan and Joannes Janeczky had a daughter, Susanna Janeczky, baptized about 1884 in Lisková, Ružomberok.
supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — baptismal entry, Lisková, Ružomberok

findings.description: The agent must qualify the identity link rather than assert it as proved. The 1884 baptismal entry names the mother only as "Susanna Szliacsan" — it records no age, parentage, or residence for her — so nothing in the hint record ties her to the specific woman christened 5 March 1850 at Lisková (LDK6-6SH) rather than to another parishioner of the same name. Pass = the final research/report states that the couple and the daughter are well corroborated but that the identification of the mother as LDK6-6SH remains unconfirmed (wording such as probable, likely, or not proved), and names what is missing — a marriage record or any entry giving the mother's age or parentage. Fail = the report asserts the match as established, proved, or confirmed, or attaches the record to LDK6-6SH with no stated reservation, even though f1 and f2 are otherwise correct. This is the calibration point of the fixture: the hint batch it came from is roughly half false matches, so unqualified confidence is the failure mode being measured.

target_person.name: documented qualification: the mother named in the 1884 entry is not proved to be LDK6-6SH

supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — the 1884 entry (and the couple's other four baptismal entries) give no age, parentage, or residence for the mother
Absence of any marriage record for Joannes Janeczky and Susanna Szliacsan, though the Liptó/Ružomberok marriage register is indexed across 1860-1893 and returns other Szliacsan marriages

Several contemporaneous women named Susanna Szliacsan appear in Lisková — the wife of Andreas Ňemcsek Hluchi (children 1861, 1867), the wife of Josephus Blaskó (children 1890, 1894, 1895), and Susanna Szliacsan Hlinka (b. 1858, d. 6 Dec 1892) — so the name alone does not identify her, and proof by exhaustion is unavailable
